changes.body:

changes.subject: Fix `round` overflow (#25125)
changes.body:
Closes https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/issues/25124

The way we get rounded value is,`(input ± power/2) / power * power`,
which has a few places which suffer overflow;
(1) adding half of the power could overflow; (2) multiply by the power
could also overflow.

In this PR, I propose two changes
- Use `HUGEINT` to take intermediate results, so smaller range types
(i.e., `SMALLINT`) don't overflow i

changes.subject: Fix #26401: EXISTS returns false when its subquery filters on an aggregate over an empty table (#26419)
changes.body:
Fixes #26401.

## Problem

`EXISTS` returns false (and `NOT EXISTS` returns rows) when its subquery
filters on an aggregate over an empty table:

```sql
CREATE TABLE t (a INT);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1), (2);
CREATE TABLE e (a INT); -- empty
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM e));
-- expected true, got false
```
